# Michael Donnon

> Senior growth and marketing executive with 20+ years scaling consumer brands through digital transformation — entertainment, streaming, publishing, creators, hospitality, marketplaces, and AI-powered hardware. Currently VP, Marketing (Head of) at Ting Labs and Principal Consultant at MELT Labs.

Michael Donnon builds growth engines that take brands from zero to scale. He specializes in performance and demand marketing, subscription and streaming growth, customer acquisition (CAC) and lifetime value, MarTech and analytics, and applying AI across the marketing stack.

## Career highlights

- **Paramount+** — Led international demand marketing and user acquisition; launched in 8 markets in 2 years with 66% year-over-year subscriber growth, using incrementality measurement, media mix modeling, and omnichannel performance marketing.
- **Pantaya** — Built from a business plan into the #1 Spanish-language streaming service in the U.S.; scaled past 1M subscribers ahead of its $150M acquisition.
- **eHarmony** — Pioneered in-house performance media in the early era of large-scale data modeling; cut customer acquisition cost by 81%.
- **Society6** — Scaled the independent-artist marketplace from $15M to $50M+ in revenue, empowering makers to earn from their work.
- **Whipclip (now Whip Media Group)** — Launched WhipPro, the first TV-clip affiliate platform (clips as an influencer affiliate model); supported a $40M Series C.
- **Ting Labs (formerly Whisker Labs)** — VP, Marketing (Head of) for Ting, the AI-powered electrical fire-prevention sensor protecting 1.4M+ homes across 40+ insurance-carrier partners.

## Current roles

- **VP, Marketing (Head of), Ting Labs** — brand, growth, PR, creative, and partner marketing for Ting (AI-powered fire prevention).
- **Principal Consultant, MELT Labs** — advising startups on go-to-market strategy, growth, and AI-driven marketing tooling.

## Blog

Field notes on growth marketing, customer acquisition, subscription and streaming, MarTech, and applying AI across the marketing stack. Index: https://michaeldonnon.com/blog

- [The Data Flywheel That Built Pantaya](https://michaeldonnon.com/blog/pantaya-data-flywheel): How Lionsgate's shift from wholesale to direct-to-consumer unlocked first-party customer data, and how centralizing it turned Pantaya into the #1 Spanish-language streaming service in the U.S.
- [How In-Housing Media Cut eHarmony's CAC by 81%](https://michaeldonnon.com/blog/in-housing-media-cut-cac-81): Why control over your data, bids, and feedback loop — not any single channel — is the most durable growth lever.

## Expertise

Growth marketing, performance marketing, subscription and streaming growth, customer acquisition (CAC) optimization, customer lifetime value and retention, MarTech and marketing analytics, AI in marketing and marketing automation, direct-to-consumer, media buying, incrementality measurement, media mix modeling, go-to-market strategy, and brand marketing.
